title: Configuration, Graceful Shutdown & Tracing
objectives: Emit structured, correlated logs with tracing spans

examples.name: shutdown.rs

exercise.prompt: Order shutdown steps: "finish in-flight requests", "receive SIGTERM", "close listening socket", "exit process".
hints: The signal arrives first; the socket closes so new work stops.
Existing requests complete (within a timeout) before exit.

options: orchestrators replace instances and in-flight work must finish
questions.explanation: Deploys kill processes; draining turns that from data loss into a non-event.

options: structured context (request id, route) to everything logged inside it
questions.explanation: Spans carry correlation: every log line in a request shares its ids.
